values.binNote: ShyvanaQ#Calc_Damage's own formula text reads 'BASE_DAMAGE + (Damage_AD_Ratio=1.1)xad + 0.3xap', which literally matches the wiki's base/AD/AP numbers, but the sheet flags this calculation as broken ('calculation names a missing data value BASE_DAMAGE'), so the 0.3 AP coefficient cannot be resolved from a clean data value row - it only appears as literal text inside the malformed calculation.

ShyvanaQ#Calc_Dragon_Form_Damage = Calc_Damage * 1.5, and Calc_Damage itself is broken in the sheet (references missing data value BASE_DAMAGE), so no bin row resolves to the base [15,22.5,30,37.5,45] or the 1.65/0.45 ratios; these numbers are only derivable by manually multiplying the (also unresolved) q_1 numbers by 1.5, per the wiki text and the Calc_Dragon_Form_Damage formula's stated multiplier.

mechanics.claim: Only the last empowered cast (Q2 in Human Form, Q3 in Dragon Form) puts the basic attack on cooldown, making the earlier casts function as free attack resets.
mechanics.quote: Only the last cast of ''Emberstrike'' puts '''Shyvana's''' basic attack on cooldown.

mechanics.claim: All Emberstrike-empowered attacks reset Shyvana's basic attack timer, allowing extra attacks in the fight window.
mechanics.quote: All casts {{tip|basic attack reset|reset}} '''Shyvana's''' basic attack timer.

mechanics.claim: The true damage cast (dragon form third cast) is always 150% of the pre-mitigation physical damage value, and cannot critically strike.
mechanics.quote: The true damage is always equal to 150% of the {{tt|pre-mitigation|Damage calculated before modifiers}} physical damage.

mechanics.claim: The area physical damage to the primary target (first/second cast) can critically strike.
mechanics.quote: The damage to the primary target is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers.

mechanics.claim: The passive on-hit magic damage deals a minimum of 10 and is capped at 200 against non-champions (monsters).
mechanics.quote: Against non-champions, this effect deals a minimum of 10 and is capped at 200.

mechanics.claim: The empowered attacks have an uncancellable windup.
mechanics.quote: empowers '''Shyvana's''' next {{tip|basic attack}} within 6 seconds to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}

mechanics.claim: Spell Shield does not block or get consumed by the empowered strikes.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Spell shield}} will '''not''' block any damage nor be consumed by the strikes.

mechanics.claim: The passive on-hit magic damage applies as proc damage rather than area damage.
mechanics.quote: The passive on-hit damage applies {{tip|proc damage}}.
